criticism: The 'mint' function has an integer overflow that allows the presale contract owner to set the balance of any user to a large value. This vulnerability can be exploited by the presale contract owner to manipulate the token balances and potentially gain an unfair advantage in the token distribution.

The 'buyTokens' function has an integer overflow in the token amount calculation, allowing the price to be set to a very high value, aka 'gofei' attack. This vulnerability can be exploited by malicious users to buy tokens at an unfair price, potentially leading to a loss of funds.

The 'withdrawFunds' function uses 'transfer' to send funds, which is vulnerable to a time attack, allowing incorrect balances and unusable funds. This vulnerability can be exploited by malicious users to steal funds from the contract.
